summary: Add a standalone Compose package for EnterpriseGlue with a customer-provided Operaton engine, optional sidecar, and first-launch access configuration.
userImpact: A configured local administrator can access the engine on first sign-in. Optional OIDC configuration grants platform and engine access through identity-provider roles.
configuration: The package includes deployment settings, versioned image inputs, and templates for direct Operaton and customer-sidecar OIDC connections.
security: The setup service uses the existing authenticated configuration API. Configuration references engine and identity-provider credentials through separate read-only secret mounts.
knownLimitations: The customer supplies the Operaton distribution, any sidecar, and the identity-provider application registration.
rollback: Restore the previous reviewed package and configuration using the documented configuration preview and rollback process.
validation: Release candidate CI starts the built download on the exact backend and frontend image digests and checks local admin access, a deployed process definition, and repeat launch.
